Play Well Dweller now on Nintendo Switch: https://ninten.do/6004adh68

At the bottom of this well lives the only creature brave enough to challenge the queen.  

Well Dweller is a dark fairy-tale Metroidvania full of charming characters! As Glimmer, a tiny bird armed with a matchstick, set off on a journey through a wretched kingdom, where you must burn the wicked queen to save your family.
